messages:
maya (Sales): Procurement asked for exact SIG/CAIQ wording for encryption & KMS. Need short 'paste-able' text covering in-transit, at-rest, BYOK/HSM, rotation, and key custody.
li (Solutions Eng): TL;DR: TLS1.3 in-transit; AES-256-GCM at-rest; envelope encryption; support BYOK via AWS/GCP/Azure KMS; HSM integrations for Private; we don't hold plaintext CMKs.
asha (Security): Add: all key operations are logged to immutable audit trails; audit exports included in compliance pack. FIPS/FedRAMP attestations are provided by customer HSM vendor when applicable.
jon (Prospect IT): Make explicit: do customer CMKs ever leave our cloud account? Procurement wants that sentence exact.
li (Solutions Eng): Exact line: "When a customer supplies a CMK in their cloud account, Redwood does not export or extract the CMK; only wrapped DEKs are transmitted and stored encrypted."
maya (Sales): Rotation ask: can we support 90/180/365 and emergency rotation?
li (Solutions Eng): Yes. Options: customer-managed (rotate in KMS); Redwood-managed rewrap (configurable cadence, default 90 days for high-sensitivity); emergency forced rewrap via incident runbook. No plaintext keys retained.
jon (Prospect IT): HSM specifics: can you accept externally-generated keys with hardware attestation (L3)?
asha (Security): Yes for Private/on-prem. We accept vendor-attested keys and include attestation docs in the compliance bundle. If Redwood generates keys on behalf of customer, that's a scoped engagement.
li (Solutions Eng): POC note: HSM hookup usually 2-4 weeks; requires KMIP/PKCS11 endpoint, network allowlist, and infra contact.
maya (Sales): Can someone give one clean SIG paragraph I can paste?
asha (Security): "Redwood enforces TLS 1.3 for data-in-transit and AES-256-GCM for data-at-rest. We use envelope encryption where data encryption keys (DEKs) are wrapped with customer-managed or provider-managed customer master keys (CMKs). Customers may provide CMKs via supported cloud KMS providers or integrate HSM-backed keys for Private deployments; all key operations are logged and auditable. When customers supply CMKs in their accounts, Redwood does not export CMKs. HSM attestation artifacts are provided by the HSM vendor and included in customer compliance deliverables."
li (Solutions Eng): I'll add an example AWS KMS ARN snippet to the presales repo.
deploy-bot: Presales crypto template updated -> https://redwood.internal/sales/presales-crypto (changelog available)
maya (Sales): Perfect. Action items: li add snippet + POC checklist; asha attach attestation checklist and audit excerpts; i'll send SIG paragraph to procurement.
jon (Prospect IT): Thanks all, will pass to legal and compliance.
